commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.

90+2' 1 - 1 Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Leganes have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
87' Diego Garcia (Leganes) was probably a bit loose with his words to Jose Munuera, who decides to show him a yellow.
87' PENALTY APPEAL after Dani Raba (Leganes) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

79' A quickly taken corner by Leganes.
78' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.

77' Here comes a substitution. Arthur Melo is given a rest as he is replaced by Oriol Romeu (Girona).

65' Here comes a substitution. Duk (Leganes) is brought on as a substitute for Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier.

62' Some neat passing and movement from Girona as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
59' Arthur Melo (Girona) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Leganes.
57' Jose Munuera interrupts the game. One of the players from Leganes won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Girona have been awarded a free kick.
54' 0 - 1 Cristhian Stuani (Girona) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
52' The linesman signals a throw-in for Girona.
51' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) sees a yellow card from Jose Munuera after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
48' Arnau Martinez (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.

43' Leganes string together a series of short passes.

39' Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Girona fail to score from a corner as Marko Dmitrovic (Leganes) leaps to collect the ball.
35' Yangel Herrera (Girona) commits a rough foul. Jose Munuera stops the game and makes a call. Leganes earn a free kick.
33' The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.
33' What a great touch by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
32' A player from Girona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
29' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.

26' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) receives the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes just over the crossbar!
25' The manager makes a subsitution with Darko Brasanac (Leganes) coming on for Adria Altimira.
25' Girona are awarded a mid-range free kick.
24' Girona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top of the net is far too weak and Marko Dmitrovic makes a simple save.
21' Yangel Herrera (Girona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
19' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and is sent off by the referee!
18' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Yangel Herrera (Girona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Leganes.
15' Adria Altimira (Leganes) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
14' Adria Altimira (Leganes) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Munuera didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

4' Leganes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
4' What a chance that is! Adria Altimira (Leganes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
